study: Buysse, Castro & Peisner-Feinberg (2010), ECRQ 25(2):194-206 — Nuestros Ninos pre-K language/literacy PD for Latino DLLs
delivery_evidence: PD = three-day institutes, individualized consultation (consultant visiting individual teachers on-site once every other week), and community-of-practice meetings (in-person, with classroom videotaping); all face-to-face (Sections 1.2.x, p.197-198).
test_alignment_evidence: Extracted outcomes include broad standardized norm-referenced tests (WLPB-R, PPVT-III, TVIP = independent) and researcher/developer-made measures (Phonological Awareness Tasks, Naming Letters, Where's My Teddy print concepts) (Table 4, p.201).
curriculum_evidence: PD content was 'designed to complement a core classroom curriculum' via specific instructional strategies/supports for DLLs; no new curriculum or materials package was adopted (intro/method, p.196-197).
outcome_timing_evidence: Child outcomes measured in spring at the end of the one school year of intervention (fall->spring difference scores); same year, no delayed follow-up (timepoint 'spring', p.199-201).
